result.reason: The clause adds the required annual frequency limit, 30 days’ prior written notice, business-hours restriction, independent confidential auditor, and prohibition on systems access. However, the cost-shifting trigger remains any “discrepancy” over 5%, rather than an underpayment exceeding 5%, so it does not fully reach the preferred position. It also unnecessarily prohibits access to Licensee’s facilities and reorders the cost provision ahead of the audit right, creating an awkward antecedent. These issues do not materially disturb unrelated commercial intent, but the revision is broader than necessary and should be cleaned up.
